The formation of car pools
Switching off the engine in a traffic jam

text: How can you reduce noise?
explanation: Driving in the high-speed range causes more noise than a low-speed driving style. In built-up areas you should drive in the highest possible gear, so that the engine causes the least possible noise. Avoid a high-speed start with squeaky tires.
options: By driving in 4th or 5th gear in built-up areas
By driving at high engine revolutions
By driving at high speed

text: What does "power sound" in the car result in?
explanation: "Power sound" in the car causes over-stimulation. This over-stimulation may distract the car driver so that he/she may miss important other signals. Bear in mind that other road users are also bothered by the noise.
options: Signals from other traffic - in particular sirens - are not heard
There is noise pollution for others even when the windows are closed
Driving errors due to the driver being diverted

text: By which percentage does the fuel consumption (l/100 km) of a middle-class car driving at 160 km/h in general increase compared to driving at the recommended speed of 130 km/h?
explanation: Compared to driving at the advisory speed limit of 130 km/h, the fuel consumption at a speed of 160 km/h usually increases very much. For example, the consumption of a mid-range car can rise by up to 35%.
options: By up to 35 %
By up to 5 %
By up to 10 %

text: When are you allowed to enter an environmental zone?
explanation: You may only drive into an environmental zone as a car driver if a valid badge is visibly attached to your vehicle that at least corresponds to the qualifying plate (red, yellow, green). Excluded from this rule are exclusively vehicles with special rights, for example historic motor vehicles.
options: When your vehicle has a corresponding emissions sticker
When your vehicle enjoys special rights
When you have a low-emission vehicle

text: Where do you have to place the emissions sticker for identifying lowemission vehicles?
explanation: As a car driver, you must ensure that the carbon emission sticker is affixed to the inside of the windshield of your vehicle so that it clearly identifies your low-emission vehicle.
options: Clearly visible on the inside of the windscreen
Clearly visible on the outside of the windscreen
Clearly visible on the inside of the rear window

text: If your car has a petrol engine but does not have an emissions sticker, are you allowed to enter an environmental zone which is sign-posted as follows?
explanation: Without visibly attached carbon emission sticker, motor vehicle drivers are not allowed to drive into an environmental zone with a gasoline engine. The badge on the vehicle must be valid and correspond at least to the qualifying plate (red, yellow, green).
options: No, because my car does not have an emissions sticker
Yes, because I am driving a car with catalytic converter with lambda control
Yes, because this prohibition only applies to diesel vehicles

text: Where can you stow your baggage so that you do not increase your fuel consumption unnecessarily?
explanation: If possible, you should only store the luggage in the trunk of your vehicle. The use of a roof rack to carry luggage results in greatly increased aerodynamic drag, often resulting in a significant increase in fuel consumption.
options: In the boot
Behind the front seats
On the roof-rack

text: Tyre wear negatively impacts the environment. How can you reduce this impact?
explanation: To reduce tyre wear (i.e. the wear on the tyres), you can drive with foresight and significantly minimise the load by regularly checking the tyre pressure in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications. Less wear = less load.
options: By employing an anticipatory driving style
By regularly checking the tyre inflation pressure in accordance with the manufacturer's guidelines
By using winter tyres in summer

text: What can contribute to environmentally-friendly driving?
explanation: If possible, carpool to reduce the number of vehicles on the road. Training can help you to adopt a fuel-efficient driving style. Electric vehicles do not emit any pollutants, so they are particularly environmentally friendly when driving.
options: Attending a practical driving training session for a fuel-efficient driving style
Using vehicles with an electric drive
Forming car pools

text: How can you save fuel if you drive a car with an automatic gearbox?
explanation: Unnecessary acceleration leads to high fuel consumption. Drive in eco mode if available. The car adapts its acceleration behaviour to reduce fuel consumption.
options: Do not press down hard on the accelerator when moving off
Use the eco mode when driving
Switch off the engine when driving down a gradient

text: What cars that are driven within designated environmental zones must display a particulate matter sticker?
explanation: In principle, all cars in a designated environmental zone are subject to the obligation to display a fine dust sticker. Work machines, ambulances, etc. are exempt.
options: - petrol engines
- diesel engines
- electric motors

text: What can result from listening to very loud music while driving a car?
explanation:
Too loud music can cause warning signals and the like of other road users to be overheard. Too loud music can also annoy, disturb and thus endanger other road users.
The driver's ability to react deteriorates due to the loud music and the resulting reduced ability to concentrate.
options: The driver fails to detect signals from other traffic
It causes a nuisance to other road users
The driver’s responsiveness is enhanced

text: Air resistance affects the fuel consumption of a vehicle. What affects air resistance the most?
explanation:
The faster you drive, the greater the air resistance acting on your vehicle. Doubling your speed results in 4 times the air resistance. 
The tread depth of the tyres has a major effect on the rolling resistance of the tyres.
The number of passengers does not directly affect the air resistance.
options: The speed travelled
The number of passengers
The profile depth of the tyres

text: You have to wait because a rail-crossing barrier is lowered. How can you now help protect the environment at this point?
explanation: By using the automatic start-stop system, the vehicle can be switched off while waiting and immediately switched on again with little effort. This minimises the emission of pollutants. Applying the handbrake has no effect on the vehicle's pollutant emissions.
options: By using the automatic start-stop system
By putting the vehicle in first gear
By activating the parking brake

text: What increases the range of an electric vehicle?
explanation: If you only brake slightly, the electric motor brakes and the kinetic energy is recovered. If you brake harder, you will be mechanically braked and the kinetic energy will not be recovered. Due to a high recuperation level, an electric car behaves like a combustion engine, so you may have to brake less strongly, i.e. mechanically. The heating in the electric car is fed directly from the battery and thus consumes energy that could also be used for driving.
options: Using a high energy recovery (recuperation) level
Reducing the heater temperature
Short, sharp acceleration

text: What is the benefit of recuperation in an electric vehicle?
explanation: Recuperation means "recovery". Just as electrical energy was converted into kinetic energy, braking converts the kinetic energy back into electrical energy, which is then fed back into the battery. This increases the range of the electric vehicle.
options: - increases range
- conserves the service brake system
- means that energy can be recovered from the braking operation

text: Your car is equipped with an automatic start-stop system. What is the environmental protection benefit from using this vehicle system?
explanation:
The automatic start-stop system automatically switches off the engine when you come to a standstill and restarts it as soon as you press one of the pedals. 
By switching off the engine, for example at traffic lights, the automatic start-stop system can reduce noise pollution and also save up to 15% fuel.
options: - fuel consumption
- noise pollution
- tyre wear

text: You are driving a car with a plug-in hybrid drive system. How can you optimise fuel consumption?
explanation:
By driving proactively - with gentle acceleration and timely braking - you can reduce your vehicle's fuel consumption. The electric motor is often used in this driving style. 
You can also reduce fuel consumption by regularly charging the battery of your plug-in hybrid on the power grid or minimize it by driving purely electrically.
options: I regularly charge the battery using the mains supply
I use the electric drive through my driving style
I only use the recuperation to charge the battery

text: How can you avoid unnecessary noise?
explanation: Unnecessary noise you avoid by properly storing or use of the tension chains and by the renewing of knocked-out tailgate hinges or closures as they can rattle loudly.
options: By replacing worn sideboard hinges or fastenings
Through correct stowing or use of chains
By greatly increasing the tyre pressure of an empty vehicle

text: What can cause noise pollution?
explanation: 3 answers are correct. Loose or worn out tailgate hinges and unsecured load, but also loose tension chains.
options: Loose chains
Loose or worn sideboard hinges
Unsecured load

text: How can you avoid noise in built-up areas, in particular with empty vehicles?
explanation: In town you can avoid particularly poor road with your empty vehicle noise by inappropriate speed.
options: By adapting your speed, particularly on a bad road surface
By driving at high speed in a low gear
By changing gear frequently with double-clutching

text: Which motor vehicles are allowed to use a road with this sign?
explanation: This road leads in an environmental zone. All buses with a corresponding emissions sticker and all trucks with a corresponding sticker are allowed to drive here. Not all cars have this plaque, so are "all car" wrong.
options: Any lorry with a corresponding emissions sticker
Any bus with a corresponding emissions sticker
Any car

text: How can you avoid creating noise?
explanation: Noise you can prevent this by you as possible befüllst empty compressed air tanks from a stationary plant and if you exchange worn out lift closures.
options: - filling empty compressed air tanks from a stationary facility, if possible
- replacing worn-out side latches
- allowing the engine to idle during longer waiting times

text: When planning your journeys, how can you make them environmentally-friendlier?
explanation: For the sake of the environment, motorists should refrain from all trips that are not absolutely necessary. Therefore, plan your trips well and make carpools as often as possible to avoid unnecessary trips. Another positive contribution to active environmental protection is the use of public transport.
options: - combining several destinations into one single trip
- forming car pools with other vehicle users
- planning to use public transport instead of my own vehicle

text: How do you drive down a descending gradient safely?
explanation: On a down grade, use the engine brake by shifting down to a lower gear. This relieves the service brakes. Under no circumstances change to idle! Because idling puts the engine brake out of action, thus the service brakes could overheat. In addition, the brake booster cannot work when the ignition is switched off. This considerably lengthens the braking distance.
options: - select a gear in which I am not required to brake a great deal
- drive in neutral
- switch the ignition off

text: What motor vehicles are permitted to enter an environment zone without a fine-particle badge?
explanation: All two- and three-wheeled motor vehicles and agricultural and forestry tractors may enter an environmental zone without the carbon emission sticker. They are exempt from the restrictions of the environmental zone. The installation of a catalytic converter does not exempt you as a car driver from the obligation to obtain an environmental badge.
options: All two and three-wheeled motor vehicles
All agricultural and forestry tractors
All motor vehicles with a catalytic converter

text: What manufacturer specifications will allow you to know if your motor vehicle is environmentally-friendly?
explanation: The emission class provides information about the emission of pollutants. The emission classes defined by the standard and/or the law subdivide products that emit exhaust emissions or interference signals. In the automotive sector, moreover, the following applies: The lower the fuel consumption, the higher the efficiency class and thus the environmental friendliness of the vehicle.
options: - about the fuel consumption
- about the efficiency category
- about the emissions class

text: Why are short journeys performed with a cold engine especially damaging to the environment?
explanation: Short trips with a cold engine usually consume more fuel than driving with a motor in operating temperature. That's why they are particularly harmful to the environment. In addition, the friction is greater in short-distance driving with a cold engine. This leads to a higher material wear.
options: - more fuel is consumed
- the level of material wear is higher
- the vehicle's battery will be over-charged

text: What causes avoidable noise?
explanation: All noise disturbances arising during normal operation of a vehicle are considered unavoidable. As a car driver, you should avoid any excess noise, for example, honking as a greeting or closing the doors very loudly. A roof rack will not cause you any avoidable noise.
options: By sounding the horn as a greeting
By firmly slamming doors shut
By driving with a roof-rack

text: How does the eco-roll mode in commercial vehicles contribute to the reduction of fuel consumption?
explanation: Because the kinetic energy of the vehicle is maximally utilized in eco-roll mode is the right answer. This has to do with the automatic neutral position of the transmission. The rolling phase will not be shortened and the engine braking effect is not increased.
options: - vehicle's kinetic energy is utilised to its maximum
- engine braking effect is increased
- vehicle's roll phase is reduced

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: When must motorcycles be submitted for official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung)?
explanation: Similarly to cars, motorcycles should be inspected every two years
options: Every two years
Every three years
Every time they are re-registered

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: How can you tell when you need to bring your vehicle in for its next vehicle roadworthiness test?
explanation: The date for the next main inspection of your vehicle can be found in the certificate of registration part 1. In addition, the appointment is clearly visible on the inspection plate printed on your license plate.
options: By looking at the inspection tag on the rear license plate
By reading the entry made in the registration certificate Part I
By reading the entry in the operating manual for my vehicle

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You have bought a second-hand car. The official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) has just been carried out. When is it due for its next official inspection?
explanation: If the main inspection of a used car has just happened, you must do the next general inspection after two years. Only for newly purchased cars, the deadline for the next general inspection is three years.
options: After two years
After one year
After three years

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You have left your registered caravan trailer for six months during the winter on a campground. What applies as far as the official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) is concerned?
explanation: Even if you have parked your caravan on a campsite, you must meet the deadline for the general inspection. Technical defects, such as rust, can occur at any time and become a safety hazard if they're not repaired.
options: The date indicated on the test stamp must be observed
The date indicated on the test stamp is extended by the time the caravan was stationary on the campground

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You have purchased a 3-year-old car for your own personal use. The vehicle roadworthiness test certificate is new. What is the time limit until the next roadworthiness test must be performed?
explanation: The first general inspection of a passenger car takes place after three years, each subsequent general inspection takes place every 2 years.

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: At what monthly interval must trucks with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t be presented for official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung)?
explanation: You have your trucks with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 3,5 t bring every 12 months for the main study.

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: At what monthly interval must buses be presented for official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung)?
explanation: Coming soon...

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You have been requested to present a truck with a gross vehicle weight rating of 18 t for its vehicle roadworthiness test. What vehicle documents do you need?
explanation: With your trucks with a maximum mass of 18 t you should use the log book and the registration certificate Part I (also called registration papers) have with you.
options: Registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
Inspection log book
Registration certificate Part II (Motor Vehicle Title)

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You are requested to present a coach for its safety test. What vehicle documents do you need?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
Inspection log book
Registration certificate Part II (Motor Vehicle Title)

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You have been requested to present a trailer with a gross vehicle weight rating of 18 t for its vehicle roadworthiness test. What vehicle documents do you need?
explanation: must be at the trailer with a maximum total weight of 18 t, which presented for general inspection, requires the registration certificate part I (registration certificate), and the log book.
options: Registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
Inspection log book
Registration certificate Part II (Motor Vehicle Title)

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is entered in the inspection log book?
explanation:
In the log book the date of the general inspection and safety check is entered.
The date of the Fahrteinschreibeüberprüfung not one of them.
options: - vehicle roadworthiness test
- safety test
- tachograph inspection

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: How can you tell when your vehicle needs to be brought in for its next safety inspection?
explanation: When you are presented to a security check next time have to, you realize the SP sign with Mark. The other two answers are wrong.
options: By looking at the safety inspection plate with the test sticker
By reading the entry made in the registration certificate Part I
By looking at the inspection tag on the license plate

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the mandatory time interval for performing the vehicle roadworthiness test for coaches and buses?
explanation: Buses and coaches drive a lot and transport people, which is why buses and coaches have to undergo a general inspection every 12 months.

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What alterations can result in the permit for use (Betriebserlaubnis) being cancelled?
explanation: Adding a sidecar or fitting tires of a different size impact the way your vehicle behave and will thus lead the cancelation of your permit for use. Fitting a rear fog lamp does not change the way your vehicle behave and thus is permitted.
options: Fitting a sidecar
Fitting tyres of a different size
Fitting a rear fog lamp

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What alterations can result in the permit for use (Betriebserlaubnis) being cancelled?
explanation: Your vehicule's next roadworthiness test can be seen either in the Part I of the registration certificate or on the inspection tag that is on your rear license plate
options: Fitting an engine of different power
Fitting fairings
Fitting a radio

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What alterations can result in the permit for use (Betriebserlaubnis) being cancelled?
explanation: Changing the gear ratio or the engine power impact the way your vehicle behave and will thus lead the cancelation of your permit for use
options: Alterations to the gear ratio
Alterations to the engine to increase power
Fitting an electric starter

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are holding a driving permit class A1. Which of the vehicles described are you allowed to drive?
explanation: With a A1 driving permit you can ride a vehicle that has a 80km/h maximum speed, 120cm3 capacity and 11kW power
options: Capacity: 120 cm³; power: 11 kW; maximum speed due to construction: 80 km/h
Capacity: 100 cm³; power: 12 kW; maximum speed due to construction: 90 km/h
Capacity: 150 cm³; power: 10 kW; maximum speed due to construction: 80 km/h

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What are the requirements when the motor liability insurance of your vehicle has expired?
explanation: It is required to have an insurance for your vehicle, without one you are not allowed to drive it
options: - may no longer be used in road traffic
- must be cancelled at the registration centre
- must be presented for inspection at the technical test centre

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: When are you not allowed to drive a motorized bicycle on public roads?
explanation: A motorized bicycle has to be insured to cover for third party damages in case of accidents and the vehicle needs to be roadworthy
options: When you have no motor vehicle liability insurance
When the motorized bicycle is not roadworthy
When no motor vehicle tax has been paid

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What is the minimum age for driving a motorized bicycle?
explanation: You must be at least 15 years old to drive a motorized bicycle

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What are the consequences when driving a motorized bicycle which can run faster than 25 km/h because it has been tuned?
explanation: Tuning your motorized bicycle to go faster than 25km/h void your permit for use, insurance and you can be fined for driving without the right permit.
options: Punishment for driving without a driving permit
Fine and punishment because permit for use and insurance cover have lapsed
There are no negative consequences as long as you do not drive faster than 25 km/h on this motorized bicycle

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What cancels the permit for use of a motorized bicycle?
explanation: Modifications that impact the behaviour of your motorcycle such as gear ratio, silencer, can result in the permit of use being canceled
options: "Clearing out" the silencer
Modifying the gear ratio
Fitting a second rear-view mirror

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: Which documents must you carry?
explanation: When driving you must always carry proof of insurance, permit for use, test certificate in case it is controlled by the police
options: Permit for use (Betriebserlaubnis)
Test certificate
Evidence of insurance

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You want to drive on public roads. Which insurance must you take out for your vehicle?
explanation: You are required by law to have a motor vehicle liability insurance to drive your vehicle which covers damanges done to third parties in case of accidents
options: Motor vehicle liability insurance
Complete vehicle insurance
Legal expenses insurance

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What proves that you have taken out a motor liability insurance for your vehicle?
explanation: You can provide an insurance certificate or have a valid insurance number plate
options: Valid insurance number plate
Evidence of insurance
Permit for use (Betriebserlaubnis)

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What is the maximum validity of the insurance number plate?
explanation: The insurance number plate is valid for a maximum of 1 year
options: 1 year
2 years
The entire vehicle life

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: The insurance indicator on your two-wheeler is no longer valid. What are the consequences if you continue to drive it so?
explanation: It is legally required to have an insurance to drive. Without one you are at risk of a fine or imprisonment. If you have an accident without an insurance, you will have to pay for any third party damage yourself
options: I must reckon with a fine or imprisonment
I will personally have to bear the costs of any accidental damage that occurs
I may only drive at walking speed

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What documents must you carry with you, if you want to drive a motorbike with an engine size larger than 200 cm³?
explanation: To drive you need to have your driver's license and the part I of your registration certificate to prove that both you and the motorcycle are authorised to drive
options: My driving licence
The registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
The registration certificate Part II (Motor Vehicle Title)

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What documents do you have to carry with you, if you want to drive a light motorcycle?
explanation: To drive you need to have your driver's license and the part I of your registration certificate to prove that both you and the motorcycle are authorised to drive
options: My driving licence
The operating licence or the registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
The registration certificate Part II (Motor Vehicle Title)

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What documents do you have to carry with you, if you want to drive a small-engined motorcycle?
explanation: You are required to have all three documents, your driver's license, an insurance certificate and an operating license or certificate of conformity
options: My driving licence
The operating licence or the Certificate of Conformity (COC document)
The insurance certificate

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What documents do you have to carry with you, if you want to drive a compulsory registrable vehicle?
explanation: As a car driver, you must always have your driver's license and vehicle registration certificate (certificate of registration part 1) with you. The vehicle title (registration certificate part 2) should be kept safely at home. It serves as proof of ownership and is not needed while driving.
options: My driving licence
The registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
The registration certificate Part II (Motor Vehicle Title)

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: Which of the following listed documents must you have with you, if you want to drive a passenger bus in occasional service within national boundaries?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: The instrument of approval
My driving licence
The insurance certificate

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: A technical modification to your vehicle means that the operating licence is extinguished. What consequences should you anticipate if you nevertheless use the vehicle on public roads?
explanation: If you use your vehicle on public roads despite the expired operating license, you will lose your insurance cover because the vehicle is no longer the one that was originally insured. Since there is an obligation to have insurance in Germany, driving without insurance is a misdemeanor. In the event of a police check, a fine will be imposed and you must expect an entry in the register of fitness to drive.
options: A public authority fine
An entry into the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders
The loss of my insurance cover

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What type of trailers used in agriculture and forestry do not have to have their own registration number?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: - with a "25" speed limit sign attached to the rear
- used to transport agricultural goods
- that may travel in excess of 25 km/h

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You want to transport hazardous goods, but have more than the permissible exempted allowance. What conditions must you fulfil in order to transport the goods?
explanation: Because you have exceeded the quantitative restrictions, you need to for your license, the required class possess and carry an ADR certificate (hazardous).
options: - hold a driving licence for the relevant driving licence class
- carry an ADR Certificate with me
- be at least 25-years old

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What is the meaning of the numbers on a sign of this kind?
explanation: These figures provide information about the transported hazardous goods. 33 is our 1203, the UN number is a risk number (highly flammable liquid) (flash point below 23 ° C) (also called material number) (gasoline or petrol)
options: - provide information about the transported hazardous goods
- are specifications issued by the vehicle manufacturer
- represent the maximum load capacity

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You would like to drive a truck with a gross vehicle weight rating of 8.0 t, which is carrying orange warning plates. Which of the following conditions do you have to fulfil?
explanation: With your truck with 8.0 t permissible gross weight, you must meet the following conditions: You have (hazardous materials certification) carry and possess a driving license class C an ADR certificate. Accident freedom has nothing to do.
options: - carry an ADR certificate with me
- hold a Class C driving licence
- have driven accident-free for at least 3 years

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: An inspection has been performed because of a technical modification made to your vehicle. What are you obliged to do?
explanation: After the technical modification of a vehicle, an acceptance report is usually created during the assessment. However, an entry may also be made in part 1 of the certificate of registration. The protocol must be carried by the vehicle driver during each journey. On request, the protocol must be presented, for example, during a stop-and-search operation.
options: - carry the inspection report or confirmation in my vehicle, and have the registration in certificate Part I corrected if necessary
- forward the inspection report or confirmation to the vehicle manufacturer
- stick the inspection report or confirmation into the designated place in the registration certificate Part II

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: The maximum design speed of a moped exceeds 25 km/h due to a prohibited technical modification. What are the consequences for me if I ride such a moped on public roads?
explanation: As soon as you change anything on your vehicle without a general operating permit or approval, the operating permit expires. Since riding a moped over 25 km/h is already class AM or higher, you are riding without a valid driving licence.
options: I am committing a criminal offence for driving without a licence
I am committing an administrative offence because I have no authorisation to operate the moped
None, provided I do not drive any faster than 25 km/h

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: An assessment is required following modifications to your vehicle. When must this be performed?
explanation: The assessment must be carried out immediately after the conversion.
options: Promptly following the modification
At the time of the next inspection
When demanded by the registration authority

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What technical modification to a motorbike will generally void the issued operating licence?
explanation: The original gear ratio of the pinion and sprocket is part of the operating license granted. All changes that affect the drive of your vehicle must be registered. This means that the operating permit expires if you change the transmission ratio.
options: Any change to the gear ratio of the pinion and chain wheel
Any change to the engine power
Installing a tankbag

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What technical modifications to a two-wheeler could result in the withdrawal of the vehicle’s type approval?
explanation:
The operating licence expires if modifications are made to the vehicle that change the vehicle type, could cause a hazard or worsen the exhaust or noise values.
The operating licence of your two-wheeler may lose its validity if, for example, you install special handlebars or use a wheel/tyre combination that is not explicitly approved for your two-wheeler. Two-wheeler is approved.
options: Fitting customised handlebars
Changing the wheel/tyre combination
Installing an identical engine

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What is the latest date on which you must display the new proof of insurance on your two-wheeler in order to continue driving without any gap in your cover?
explanation: From 1 March 2023, the new insurance licence plates will become invalid. In order to be allowed to continue riding without transition, take care of a new licence plate in good time.
options: - 1st March
- 1st January
- 1st June

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: The validity of the insurance plate on your bike has expired. What are the consequences for its use on public roads?
explanation:
It is forbidden to use a two-wheeler on public roads without a valid insurance license plate. The law requires compulsory insurance so that possible accident costs are covered. 
You are allowed to push your two-wheeler on a sidewalk without a valid insurance license plate, as this does not count as “driving”.
options: - no longer ride the bike
- push the bike on a pavement
- park the bike in a car park

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: The suspension of your motor vehicle has been lowered and an expert opinion must be obtained. When is this required?
explanation: If you lower a car you need this change on the chassis to be officially accepted. Therefore, the assessment must be done immediately. You must always carry the report or confirmation with you and, if necessary, have this technical change registered in the certificate of registration part 1, the registration certificate.
options: Immediately after the alteration
Together with the next official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung), at least 1 year after the alteration
When requested by the vehicle licensing authority

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are holding a driving permit class B. Your car has the following specifications: - empty mass 1900 kg - permissible total mass 2400 kg - permissible towed load 1500 kg Which trailer are you allowed to tow?
explanation: Regardless of the information, a vehicle plus a trailer may only have a restricted total weight of 3,500 kg for a Class B driving license. When the car is fully loaded, the loaded trailer must not weigh more than 1,100 kg. Exception: The car has a maximum permissible mass of 3,500 kg and the trailer weighs less than 750 kg.

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are holding a driving permit class C. Your truck has the following specifications: - empty mass 9000 kg - permissible total mass 18000 kg - permissible towed load 22000 kg Which trailer are you allowed to tow?
explanation: The trailer has a maximum authorized mass of 750 kg must not be exceeded for Class C.
options: 750 kg

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are holding a driving permit class C1. Your truck has the following specifications: - empty mass 3500 kg - permissible total mass 6200 kg - permissible towed load 9300 kg Which trailer are you allowed to tow?
explanation: With these data your followers must not weigh over 750 kg more.
options: 750 kg

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are holding a driving permit class D. Your bus has the following specifications: - empty mass 13000 kg - permissible total mass 18000 kg - permissible towed load 2000 kg Which trailer are you allowed to tow?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: 750 kg

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What is the maximum period for which a driving licence class D or D1 is issued?
explanation: Coming soon...

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What can result in your qualification as a bus driver having to be reviewed?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: - your knowledge and ability as a bus driver
- your physical or mental qualification
- your employer's reliability

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: When does a driving permit class D or D1 lapse?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: When validity has not been renewed in time
When you have not driven a bus for more than 1 year
When your employment as bus driver ends

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: When is a bus driver not allowed to drive?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: When he is suffering from a notifiable contagious disease
When a member of his household is suffering from a notifiable contagious disease
When he is seriously indisposed

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: All the seats on your bus are equipped with the prescribed safety belts. You are driving in non-regular traffic. What is correct?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: You must wear your safety belt
You must inform passengers that they have to wear safety belts
Safety belts do not have to be worn inside built-up areas

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: Which document do you have to carry with you for a bus in cross-border traffic within the EU states?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: A certified copy of the valid licence for commercial cross-border passenger traffic with coaches and buses
An approved timetable
A valid description of the location

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What is regulated by the road haulage act?
explanation: The road transport law regulates the paid transport of goods and the businesslike goods. Private freight transport is not included.
options: Commercial goods transport
Goods transport against payment
Private goods transport

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are performing a cross-border furniture removal operation. What transport document do you have to carry with you?
explanation: You have to carry the CMR at an international furniture transport. CRM is a CMR Convention.
options: The CMR way bill
The registration certificate Part II
Proof of insurance

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You hold a certificate of approval in accordance with the passenger transportation law. When must this be carried during the occasional carriage of passengers?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: - within Germany
- outside of Germany within the EU
- outside of the EU

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You carry out a household dissolution in return for payment. For moving the furniture you use a motor vehicle with a gross vehicle weight rating of 4.5 t. Do you need a permit under the Road Haulage Act in order to transport the load?
explanation: Since your truck has a maximum authorized mass of 3.5 t, you need at a furniture transport with a total weight of 4.5 tons a permit for the road transport law.
options: Yes, because the motor vehicle has a gross vehicle weight rating in excess of 3.5 t
No, because the actual purpose of the job is the household dissolution
No, because small firms do not need a permit

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What should you note about the classes C, C1, D and D1 driving licence?
explanation: All three answers are correct. The classes mentioned are all limited to a maximum of 5 years. The extension of the driving license can be applied for at the earliest 6 months before the expiry of the validity period (5 years) and the end of the validity period is noted on the driving license.
options: The driving licence is issued for a maximum limited period of 5 years
The earliest that an application can be made to renew the driving licence is 6 months prior to expiry
The end of the driving licence's validity period is indicated on the driving licence document

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are to transport hazardous goods, but have more than the permissible exempted allowance. What proof must you carry with you to perform the transport?
options: A valid ADR training certificate
A valid driving licence for the relevant vehicle class
A valid record for the last hazardous goods transport

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: Where will you find information on the validity period of your licence to drive?
options: On your driving licence
On your driver card
On your driver qualification card

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What proof do you need to extend the period of validity of your driving licence?
explanation: To extend the validity of your driving license, you will need a renewed proof of suitability and eyesight. First aid training does not have to be repeated.
options: - my aptitude
- my vision
- my first aid training

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: You are driving a lorry in commercial freight transport. What do you have to be able to prove on request?
explanation:
As a truck driver in commercial freight transport, you must have the following documents with you:
        1. Documentation for transport: According to Section 7 Paragraph 1 No. 3 of the Road Haulage Act (GüKG), a transport document must be carried that contains information about the goods being transported, the sender and the recipient.
        2. Valid professional driver qualification: According to the Professional Driver Qualification Act (BKrFQG), you must provide evidence of appropriate qualifications, for example by entering the key number “95” on your driving license.
        3. Valid liability insurance for damage to goods: According to Section 7a GüKG, proof of liability insurance for damage to goods is required to cover liability for transported goods.

Carrying these documents is required by law and serves to ensure orderly and safe road transport.
options: The documentation for transport
A valid professional driver qualification
A valid cargo liability insurance policy

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: When do you need an authorisation to transport goods in accordance with the Road Haulage Act?
explanation: You only need this authorization for the transport of goods in commercial freight transport.
options: - transport is carried out on a commercial basis
- the transport distance is more than 100 km
- a vehicle combination is used for transport

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: When performing the occasional carriage of passengers, what document must you present for inspection by the competent persons upon demand?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: The registration certificate Part I
The approval for the occasional carriage of passengers
The passenger accident insurance certificate

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: As a bus driver, you carry passengers by means of a regular international services operation. What documents do you have to carry with you?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: The registration certificate Part I
The permits needed for the country of destination
The registration certificate Part II

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: Which requirements must be met so that a farm trailer is exempt from registration?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: The trailer may only be towed by truck tractors or self-propelled working machines when not driving faster than 25 km/h
The trailer may only be used for agriculture or forestry purposes
The trailer must be submitted for an official test (Hauptuntersuchung) every 12 months

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What are the consequences of an invalid insurance indicator on using a vehicle on public roads?
explanation: It is legally required to have an insurance to drive. Without one you are not allowed to drive and are at risk of a fine or imprisonment. If you have an accident without an insurance, you will have to pay for any third party damage yourself
options: - no longer be used
- continue to be used, if the driver is prepared to personally pay for damage caused
- continue to be used, if you do not drive faster than a cyclist

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: Which of the following listed documents must you have with you, if you want to drive a cross-border passenger bus within the EU?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: The EU passenger waybill
The personal log-book
No particular documents

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: How long is the validity period of an ADR Certificate detailing a driver's training for transporting hazardous goods?
explanation: The ADR certificate (the driver training for hazardous cargo) is valid for 5 years and must then be renewed.
options: 5 years
3 years
Unlimited

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What duties do you have when driving a commercial freight transport vehicle?
explanation: Your duties in a commercial freight are to take all necessary measures for securing the load and carry an accompanying document in which the transported goods, loading and unloading and the client are given.
options: - implement all the measures necessary to secure the load
- carry with me an accompanying document detailing the transported cargo, the place of loading and unloading and the instructing party
- create an accompanying document for the load

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What vehicles - including with trailer - may be driven by someone even before their 18th birthday if they hold a Class T driving licence?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: 40 km/h
50 km/h
60 km/h

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What vehicles - including with trailer - may be driven by someone after their 18th birthday if they hold a Class T driving licence?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: 60 km/h
70 km/h
80 km/h

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What modifications to the vehicle could result in the license to drive it being cancelled?
explanation: Changing the type of steering wheel or modifying the exhaust system impact the way your vehicle behave and will thus lead the cancelation of your permit for use. Replacing an engine by a similar one does not change the way your vehicle behave and thus is permitted.
options: Installing a different type steering wheel
Modifying the exhaust system
Installing a replacement engine

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: Which of the following regulations govern the road transport of hazardous goods?
explanation: These regulations govern the transport and are included in the Dangerous Goods Ordinance (GGVSEB) and ADR (European Agreement concerning the International Carriage of Dangerous Goods by Road)
options: German Regulations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods by Road, Rail and Inland Waterways ("GGVSEB")
ADR
German Civil Code ("BGB")

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What is the period of validity of the authorisation for occasional passenger services (national) with coaches or buses?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Maximum 10 years
Maximum 5 years
Maximum 2 years

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Admission To Road Traffic Vehicle Documents Driving Licence
text: What proofs may be necessary for cross-border road haulage services?
explanation: 3 answers are correct. As evidence for cross-border freight ECMT license, the bilateral authorization and the Community license shall apply.
options: - ECMT permit
- bilateral authorisation
- Community licence

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the correct response if, when reversing a combination vehicle the view to the rear is impeded?
explanation: If you drive backwards with a vehicle combination and your view is restricted to the rear, you must make sure that you do not endanger other road users. You should therefore be advised into traffic. This also applies to factory premises.
options: If the line-of-sight is broken to the person directing, the vehicle must be stopped
A person directing is only required when driving into a priority road
A person directing is not needed when on a factory premises

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the period of validity of the authorisation for other occasional passenger services (national) with motor vehicles?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Maximum 5 years
Maximum 10 years
Maximum 2 years

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the maximum number of trailers allowed to be towed by a class B truck?
explanation: Only one trailer may be carried behind motor vehicles (class B). However, none for passenger transport (bus trailer).

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You are driving on a road with potholes and your trailer starts "jumping". What must you do?
explanation: You should not accelerate any further as this would cause the trailer to build up vibrations. Brake slightly instead. A reduced speed brings the trailer back under control.
options: Reduce speed in order to avoid skidding
Accelerate to keep the combination of vehicles straight
Proceed at the same speed and avoid potholes

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What must you remember when you want to use a trailer with overrun brakes behind your car?
explanation: Make sure that the breakaway cable is properly fastened. It has the effect that, in case of detachment, the trailer brake will automatically tighten and bring the trailer to a halt. The overrun brake has nothing to do with the maximum permissible speed.
options: The actual total mass of the trailer must not exceed the towed load permitted for the car
The breakaway cable is connected to the towing vehicle
The permissible maximum speed for this combination of vehicles is 60 km/h, including on autobahns

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is designated as towed load?
explanation: Only the actually dragged load is called trailer load, in other words the weight of the trailer. The manufacturer sets this value for carrying a trailer.
options: The actual load being towed
The permissible total mass of the trailer
The useful load of the trailer

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You want to pull a trailer. When do additional rear-view mirrors have be to attached to your motor vehicle?
explanation: As a car driver you are responsible for a sufficient view of the vehicle. If visibility is compromised by a trailer and the prescribed mirrors are no longer sufficient, you will need to install additional mirrors.
options: If it is not possible to observe all relevant road traffic situations without additional rear-view mirrors
If the load platform of the trailer exceeds a width of 1.5 m and a height of 1 m
If you are pulling a caravan or a trailer used in agriculture and forestry

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You want to tow a brake-equipped trailer. Where can you find details or guidelines on the permissible towable mass of your car?
explanation: The information on how much weight a towing vehicle can tow can be found in the registration certificate (part 1) and in the vehicle owner's manual.
options: In the registration certificate Part I of my car
In the registration certificate Part I of my trailer
In the insurance certificate

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You want to couple a trailer to your car. Where will you find details about the maximum permissible vertical loading of your car?
explanation: Information about the permissible trailer load can be found in part 1 in the certificate of registration of the car towing vehicle and in its operating instructions.
options: - operating manual
- registration certificate Part I
- registration certificate Part II

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You want to pull a trailer. What must you be aware of?
explanation: The manufacturer specifies how high the maximum drawbar load, the payload and the trailer load may be. If the values are not adhered to, it can have an effect on the driving behaviour and thus lead to an accident.
options: - towable weight of the towing vehicle
- vertical load of the hitch
- load of the trailer

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You are driving with a trailer on a road with potholes. Your combination vehicle begins to swing up. What must you do now?
explanation: By reducing the speed, you can prevent skidding.
options: - reduce my speed to avoid skidding
- accelerate to keep the combination vehicle in a straight line
- counter-steer quickly to prevent skidding

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What number of trailers may be towed behind a car?
explanation: According to StVZO § 32 a Carrying trailers: Only one trailer may be carried behind vehicles, but not for passenger transport (bus trailer).

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You want to hitch a trailer with a maximum authorised mass over 750 kg to your car. What must you ensure in this situation?
explanation:
In order for the trailer to be properly connected, the clutch claw must completely enclose the ball head. If the fuse snaps in, it is guaranteed that the clutch claw cannot dissolve independently. Check this with hand and eye. In addition, trailers with a permissible total mass of over 750 kg must also be secured with a tear -off rope. Check before driving as to whether it is appropriate.
After you have checked all the connections, you must also check the lighting before starting drive.
options: That the handle of the ball coupling must be visually and mechanically checked
The breakaway cable is properly fitted
Following coupling, that the proper functioning of the trailer’s lighting system is checked

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: You are driving a car with a fully loaded trailer equipped with overrun braking. What special aspect should be noted here?
explanation:
So that the trailer does not roll away when you separate it from the towing vehicle, you should put on the pendant's parking brake. The trailer brake can overheat during longer downhill rides. In this case, you may have to take breaks when you leave.
The brake brake is only activated when the trailer on the towing vehicle. If you drive uphill, this may not be the case when braking, depending on how strong you brake.
options: Longer downhill drives can cause the trailer brakes to overheat

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What can affect the driving stability of a towed trailer?
explanation:
The load of a trailer should be distributed so that the center of gravity is as close as possible to the axle of the trailer. This ensures optimal driving stability and controllability of the trailer.
A load center of gravity that is far back can have a serious impact on the driving stability of your trailer. This can cause the trailer to sway more easily during sudden steering movements or at higher speeds, increasing the risk of an accident.
If the tire pressure on your trailer is too low, it can affect the driving stability of your trailer. On the one hand, low tire pressure leads to poorer road grip, which makes your trailer more uncontrollable when cornering. On the other hand, low tire pressure leads to increased tire wear, which increases the risk of tire damage while driving.
A shock absorber that is already leaking can also have a negative impact on the driving stability of your trailer. The leaking shock absorber on your trailer loses its damping properties, which can lead to unstable driving behavior and dangerous situations that are difficult to control.
options: A centre of gravity that is far back in the trailer
Insufficient tyre pressure in the trailer tyres
A leaking shock absorber

explanation: The operation of this combination is permitted if you t at least three renounce payload, because the total load is 43 tonnes. (34 + t 25 t - 16 t = 43 t).
options: - is allowed if you carry at least 3 t less than the useful load
- is allowed also if the semitrailer is fully loaded with 34 t
- is under no circumstances allowed

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the maximum length allowed for a combination of vehicles comprising a lorry and two-axle trailer including load?
explanation: Your train consisting of a truck and two-axle, and its load may be more than 20,75 meters long.

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: How do you determine the maximum authorised combination mass of a vehicle combination consisting of a towing vehicle with rigid drawbar trailer?
explanation:
You calculate the total permissible towed mass using the following data:
Maximum authorised mass of the towing vehicle plus the maximum authorised mass of the trailer minus the drawbar load of the trailer, if this is greater than the maximum authorised drawbar load of the towing vehicle.
options: - maximum authorised mass of the trailer less the vertical load of the trailer, if this is greater than the permissible vertical load of the towing vehicle
- maximum authorised mass of the trailer less the vertical load of the trailer, if this is less than the permissible vertical load of the towing vehicle
- load capacity of the trailer less the vertical load of the trailer, if this is greater than the permissible vertical load of the towing vehicle

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the maximum permissible width of this truck tractor with mounted implement?
explanation: Coming soon...

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the maximum permissible dimension X for truck tractors?
explanation: Coming soon...

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the maximum permissible dimension X for agricultural truck tractors?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: 8 m

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the maximum permissible length of the truck and trailer with load?
explanation: Coming soon...

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: From which width onwards must truck tractors be equipped with these warning plates?
explanation: Coming soon...

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: What is the maximum permissible length of dimension X?
explanation: Coming soon...

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: The Road Haulage Act applies to commercial haulage vehicles or vehicle combinations in excess of what gross vehicle weight rating?
explanation: From a maximum mass of 3.5 t for motor vehicles or vehicle combinations with businesslike transport of goods is the road transport law observed.
options: Over 3.5 t
2.8 t and over
3.0 t and over

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
text: The validity period of one of your driving licence classes has expired. What are the consequences of this?
explanation: The consequences are the driving motor vehicles in this class is prohibited and the license of this class is extinguished. It must not be used for private trips.
options: The driving licence has ended for this class
It is prohibited to drive motor vehicles in this class
The driving licence for this class may only still be used for private journeys

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What must you be aware of when using navigation systems and road maps?
explanation: When using a navigation system, you should be aware that even current content can deviate from reality and content can become outdated shortly after purchase. There is no guarantee that the content is up to date despite automatic updating.
options: The contents may become outdated just a short time after purchase
Even up-to-date contents may differ from reality
All navigation systems can update themselves automatically

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What must you be aware of when route planning abroad?
explanation: Before driving, find out which regulations apply abroad.
options: - applicable conditions for inner city road use (a city toll for example)
- labelling requirements for driving in environment zones
- applicable speed limits

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What must you take into account when planning routes?
explanation: For your route planning please pay attention to possible traffic delays due to road works and possible traffic delays by holiday traffic in different provinces.
options: Possible traffic obstructions due to holiday traffic in different federal states
Possible traffic obstructions due to building sites
A route which is as interesting as possible

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: Can information in road maps deviate from actual conditions?
explanation: Road maps may be shortly overhauled after the release and outdated. Eighth please as possible to the date.
options: Road maps can be outdated even before they are published
Road maps are valid for 4 years and then have to be replaced
Road maps issued by automobile clubs and petrol companies never deviate from actual conditions

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What does the scale 1:300,000 on a road map tell you?
explanation: This standard says that 1 centimeter equals on the road map 3 kilometers.
options: 1 centimetre on the map corresponds to 3 kilometres
1 centimetre on the map corresponds to 300 kilometres
1 centimetre on the map corresponds to 30 kilometres

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: You are driving along the autobahn and want to go directly to Unterbach. Where do you leave the autobahn?
explanation: If you want to Unterbach, you should exit onto the highway exit Dusseldorf / Erkrath.
options: At the Düsseldorf/Erkrath autobahn exit
At the Düsseldorf-Süd autobahn intersection
At the Hilden autobahn intersection

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: You want to drive your vehicle from Hamburg to Rome. Which map scale should you use for initial overall planning?
explanation: When your trip from Hamburg to Rome you can with the scale of 1: 500,000 to carry out a first overall route planning.

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: Which information is given by the key on a roadmap?
explanation: A legend of a road map provides you an explanation of the symbols and characters used in the card and a distance ruler for quick removal determination.
options: Explanation of the symbols and signs on the map
Ruler to quickly establish distances
Historical overview on the history of the map

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: Autobahn numbers have the following meanings:
explanation: The numbering on motorways mean: Regional highways leading three-digit numbers, and north-south highways leading odd numbers.
options: North/South autobahns have uneven numbers
Regional autobahns have three-digit numbers
East/West autobahns have uneven numbers

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: You want to drive your truck with a total permissible mass of more than 7.5 t on the autobahn from Hanover to Munich. Which average speed can you reckon with?
explanation: With your trucks over 7.5 t permissible total mass on the highway from Hannover to Munich you should expect h with an average speed of 70 km /.
options: 70 km/h
80 km/h
40 km/h

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: You want to transport live animals over a large distance. What do you have to consider when planning the route?
explanation: If you want to transport live animals over long distances, you should consider when planning the route Animal Transport Regulation, the charge control and charge maintenance and service stations and rest stops.
options: Checks and maintenance of the load
Stops for fuel and rests
Animal protection regulations for transports

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: You want to establish a route plan to drive from Frankfurt (Oder) to Kiel. You have to exchange loads at different intermediate stops. Which information is necessary to plan your route in terms of roads and time?
explanation: In your directions from Frankfurt (Oder) to Kiel, with different intermediate stations, because of charge exchange, the following information should be provided: starting point, destination, order of the waypoints, planned charging periods and breaks.
options: Starting point, destination, sequence of intermediate stops, scheduled loading times and travel interruptions
Location, destination, intermediate stops, maximum speed
Location, destination, driving speed

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: You are planning your trip using a road map with a scale of 1:200,000. 1 cm on the map corresponds to how many kilometres in reality?
explanation: In your planning with a road map with a scale of 1: 200,000 corresponds to 1 cm 2 kilometers on the map.
options: 2 km
10 km
20 km

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What must you be aware of when using a navigation system in the vehicle?
explanation: When using a navigation system, please note that the information issued are recommendations, the navigation device should not interfere with your view and the navigation system should not be lying around unsecured in the car.
options: The information provided consists of recommendations
The navigation device should not impede the driver's field of vision
The navigation device should not lie around in the car unattached

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What activities could pose a highly risky distraction while driving?
explanation: All three activities distract the car driver from traffic during the journey. The car driver might not be able to recognize dangerous situation in time.
options: Entering an address in the sat-nav
Writing a text message
Using the telephone even through a hands-free unit

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: Why do the driving and rest periods have to be taken into account in the route planning?
explanation: to be considered for route planning on driving and rest periods is important because it ensures that you can comply with the prescribed breaks and impairments of driving should be avoided.
options: - ensures that the driver is able to observe the prescribed rest times
- is intended to avoid impairments to the driving style
- it reduces the length of the driving distance

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What should be taken into account with the route planning?
explanation: You should take into account the driving and rest times for your route planning, the holidays of the individual states and also in cross-border traffic, the provisions of that other State.
options: The driving and rest periods
The public holidays of the specific federal states
The legal provisions of the other country in the case of cross-border transport

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What must be observed when using an electronic navigation device?
explanation: please check if a map update was carried out at regular intervals and the goal should be entered when the vehicle is stationary.
options: The card should be updated at regular intervals
The destination should be entered when the vehicle is stationary
The instructions on the navigation device should be followed at all times

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What should you factor in when planning your route?
explanation: When planning the route, you should consider all 3 answers. The driving and rest times, the public holidays of the individual federal states and the provisions of the other state for cross-border traffic.
options: The driving and rest periods
The public holidays of the individual federal states
The rules of other countries when undertaking cross-border journeys

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What should you factor in when planning your route?
explanation: When planning your route, you should take into account the driving and rest times and the regulations of the other country in the case of cross-border traffic.
options: The driving and rest periods
The rules of other countries when undertaking cross-border journeys
The prohibition on driving on the public holidays of the individual federal states

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What should be observed in relation to route planning?
explanation: When planning your route, you should be aware of possible traffic obstructions due to road works, the holiday travel regulations and driving and rest times. All answers are correct.
options: The rules contained in the German summer holiday traffic regulations
The regulations on driving and rest periods
Possible obstructions of traffic caused by roadworks

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: You are transporting general cargo. What should be noted in relation to route planning?
explanation: When transporting general cargo, you should consider all 3 answers. The order of loading and unloading points, the time required for loading and unloading (save time), and the application of driving and rest times in connection with the Working Hours Act. (rest and recharge your batteries)
options: The sequence of the points for loading and unloading
The time required for loading and unloading
The application of the rules on driving and rest periods in conjunction with the German Working Time Act

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What should you note when using your navigation system?
options: You must consider the vehicle dimensions on the proposed route
Mounted mobile navigation systems may not impede the forward view
The arrival time calculated at the start of the journey takes account of mandatory driving and rest periods

themeName: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
chapterName: Reading A Road Map And Route Planning
text: What must you note when driving in other European countries in winter?
options: - minimum tread depth of tyres
- obligation to fit your vehicle with winter tyres
- obligation to carry snow chains in your vehicle

chapterName: Driving Operation Driving Physics Driving Technique
text: Your motorcycle is fully loaded. How do you drive down a long mountain pass road?
explanation: When driving down over a long period of time, your brakes are at risk to overheat. To avoid this, try to use the braking effect of the engine on a low gear and limit the acceleration/deceleration in between turns.
options: Utilize the braking effect of the engine by changing to a lower gear
Do not drive too fast between bends in order to avoid overheating the brakes
Use the front wheel brake only

chapterName: Driving Operation Driving Physics Driving Technique
text: When is there a danger of the motorcycle's front wheel lifting off the road?
explanation: Fast and sudden accelerations could lead to the front wheel lifting off the road. This could happen when accelerating on low gear or releasing the clutch suddenly when starting to drive
options: On rapid acceleration in low gear
If the clutch is suddenly released on starting off
When the handbrake is pulled on hard

chapterName: Driving Operation Driving Physics Driving Technique
text: You have changed the motorcycle. For the first time, you are driving a motorcycle with fairings. What is different?
explanation: Fairings do not decrease the danger of falling. However, it increases the sensitivity to the side wind but diminishes the front wind which creates a tendency to drive faster
options: As the wind pressure is reduced, there is a tendency to drive faster
Sensitivity to side wind increases
The danger of falling has decreased

chapterName: Driving Operation Driving Physics Driving Technique
text: What must you particularly remember when carrying side-mounted cases or bags?
explanation: Adding luggage to your motorcycle will impact its behavior on the road. Make sure you do not exceed the maximum speed recommended by your manufacturer for driving with luggage and that you distribute weight evenly (on the right and left) to keep your motorcycle stable
options: To avoid an uneven distribution of weight
Not to exceed the top speed recommended by the manufacturer of the motorcycle
With a full load, apply the rear brakes only

chapterName: Driving Operation Driving Physics Driving Technique
