explanation: When coupling a trailer with a combined coupling heads close both lines at the same time and connect without combined heads the first brake line (yellow coupling head)
options: First connect the service line (yellow hose coupler)
If the hose couplers are combined, connect both lines at the same time
First connect the emergency line (red hose coupler)

text: What must you remember when coupling up a trailer?
explanation: When coupling a trailer, please release the parking brake after coupling and remove different colored chocks coupling parts must not be connected.
options: You are not allowed to connect coupling parts with different colours
Release the parking brake and remove the wheel chocks when the trailer is coupled up
First connect the emergency line

text: What must you remember after you have coupled up a trailer to an automatic trailer coupling?
explanation: (Automatically) to autonomously functioning, trailer hitch you should pay attention to the position of the control pin and the coupling pin must be fully engaged.
options: The coupling pin must be fully engaged
The position of the control pin
You must not be able to move the coupling jaw to the side after the coupling pin has engaged

text: Which requirements must be fulfilled before coupling a semi-trailer?
explanation: be unlocked during coupling of a semitrailer has the fifth wheel (tractor) and opened our fifth wheel and kingpin (semitrailers) must be something on the same level.
options: The fifth wheel must be unlocked and opened
The fifth wheel and coupling must be at roughly the same height
All tube and cable connections must be established

text: The coupling pins of your trailer hitch have a diameter of 38 mm when new. What should you note regarding wear?
explanation: If you notice wear on the coupling bolt (e.g. 2 mm) you have to have the bolt replaced, because the diameter must not be less than 36.5 mm on the entire circumference of the coupling surface. There must also be no excessive play in the lower fastener guide.
options: The diameter may not fall below 36.5 mm across the entire extent of the coupling surface
The lower pin guide should not exhibit any excessive free play
The coupling pin may fall below a single-sided diameter of 36.5 mm on the coupling surface

text: A considerable amount of longitudinal play becomes apparent in the towing device of the trailer. What effect can this have?
explanation: If you notice significant longitudinal play in the trailer drawbar, this will affect the final cross member of the towing vehicle (damage) and the trailer can tear off.
options: Damage could be caused to the cross beam of the towing vehicle
The trailer could shear off
The tyres on the rear axle could be overloaded

text: How much longitudinal play may there be in the drawbar of the hitch?
explanation: A longitudinal play in the drawbar of your trailer is not permitted and must be remedied immediately.
options: No longitudinal play is permitted
Maximum longitudinal play of 1.5 mm
The permissible longitudinal play depends on the diameter of the drawbar

text: The drawbar of a full trailer is to be kept level with the coupling height of the approaching towing vehicle. How is this ensured?
explanation: To bring the drawbar of a drawbar trailer to coupling height, use the height adjustment of the trailer.
options: - height adjustment system of the trailer
- person directing the manoeuvre
- height adjustment system of the towing vehicle

text: How can you check the state of wear of the drawbar or the turntable of a full trailer?
explanation: You can check with your towing vehicle whether there is any wear on the drawbar or the slewing ring of the trailer by starting briefly when the trailer is secured with the parking brake.
options: By briefly starting up with the towing vehicle, provided the trailer is secured using the parking brake
By deactivating the advance, and braking hard several times while driving
By briefly starting up with the towing vehicle, provided the trailer is secured using the service brake

text: How much wear is permitted on the diameter of the drawbar eye of the hitch?
explanation: The wear on the drawbar eye must be large in diameter mm 1.5 maximum.
options: 1.5 mm
1.0 mm
2.0 mm

text: What is the maximum permissible wear measured across the diameter of the towing ring of a drawbar?
explanation: The diameter must not exceed 1.5 mm.
options: 1.5 mm
1.0 mm
2.0 mm

text: Your tractor is equipped with a K 80 coupling system with manual locking. What must you ensure when coupling a trailer?
explanation: You must lock the hold-down on the coupling system after coupling and adjust the height of the trailer coupling to the respective trailer. The system (K 80) does not require lubrication before each use.
options: - lock the retainer on the coupling system after coupling the trailer
- adjust the height of the trailer coupling on the relevant trailer
- lubricate the coupling system each time before using

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: Why must you ensure the brake fluid is changed regularly in accordance with the vehicle manufacturer's instructions?
explanation: You should have the brake fluid changed regularly according to the manufacturer's specifications, because this keeps the brake system functioning properly even under high loads, so that the water content in the brake fluid does not become unacceptably high and so that the components of the brake system are not damaged.
options: To ensure that the braking system remains functional even under a high load
To ensure that the proportion of water in the brake fluid does not exceed the permitted level
To prevent damage to the components of the braking system

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: If you do not regularly exchange the air filter, what effects does this have on the engine?
explanation: A waiver of the regular air filter changes can increase the proportion of pollutant in the exhaust gases. The power of the engine may decrease and the consumption may increase.
options: The percentage of harmful substances in the exhaust gases can increase
Fuel consumption can increase
Engine power can decrease

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: Why should you check the tread of the tyres regularly?
explanation: 3 answers are correct. A regular review is necessary because uneven worn tires adversely affect your driving. Because uneven worn tires may indicate defective shock absorbers or suspension means and because unilateral worn tires can indicate wrong track or camber settings.
options: Because tyres worn on one side can indicate incorrect track or camber alignment
Because irregularly worn tyres can indicate defective shock absorbers or suspension elements
Because irregularly worn tyres can have a negative influence on road behaviour

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: Why should you check your vehicle before the start of the cold weather period?
explanation: Because the windshield washer system can freeze and because the battery may fail. In addition, the cooling water system of the engine can freeze up in cold weather. All three answers are correct.
options: Because the engine's cooling water system can freeze
Because the battery can fail
Because the windscreen washer system can freeze

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: What preventive maintenance can you carry out on the battery?
explanation: Check cable connections and battery holder are tight and clean and grease the poles are right. Since acid does not age, it must not be replaced.
options: Check that cable connections and battery support are firmly in place
Clean and grease the poles
Exchange battery acid

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: Why is it important to regularly check the engine's coolant?
explanation: A regular check of the cooling liquid is important because it can lead to the absence of an engine failure and the engine could overheat. Please check it from time to time.
options: A lack of coolant can cause engine damage
A lack of coolant can cause the engine to overheat
A lack of coolant is not important because it is always automatically filled up by the expansion tank

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: Why should the planned services be carried out on your vehicle?
explanation: The inspections provided for you should perform because so environmentally relevant vehicle components are tested for functionality, ensuring that all of the vehicle components are tested for functionality and reaching the wear limits of safety-related vehicle components is detected in time.
options: To ensure that the wear limits of vehicle parts that are relevant to safety are recognised in good time
To ensure that vehicle parts that are relevant to safety are checked for functionality
To ensure vehicle parts relevant to the environment are checked for functionality

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: Why should you always carry out a control on your vehicle before you drive off?
explanation: A descent control to your vehicle you should carry out all the above reasons. Because this is the safety of the vehicle. so because the risk of a breakdown is reduced while driving but also because by the wear of vehicle parts is detected early.
options: Because this reduces the risk of a breakdown during your journey
Because this allows wear of vehicle parts to be recognized in good time
Because this is to ensure the vehicle is roadworthy

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: How are lubricating points lubricated on motor vehicles and trailers?
explanation: The lubrication points are lubricated with manual lubrication with a hard press on the appropriate lubrication points. In central lubrication systems from a reservoir is also possible and correct.
options: In the case of central lubricating systems, from a reservoir
In the case of manual lubrication, using a grease gun on the lubricating points in question
By regularly checking the level of the engine oil

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: What should be noted when lubricating a vehicle?
explanation: You should make sure that a noticeable fat entry is to recognize and clean the grease nipples before greasing and cleaning.
options: The lubrication nipples must be cleaned before the lubricant is applied
A noticeable layer of grease should be visible
Old and new grease may not be combined with one another

chapterName: Maintenance Of Motor Vehicles And Timely Arrangement Of Repairs
text: What maintenance is necessary on trailers?
explanation: You have all the moving parts (drawbar & slewing ring) wait on the trailer.
options: Lubricate the fifth wheel
Lubricate the towing fork
Lubricate brake pads

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What is the maximum permissible width of a vehicle including load (excluding vehicles with farming or forestry products and refrigerator vehicles)?
explanation: The width of thy vehicle (except vehicles agricultural or forestry products and refrigerated vehicles) including cargo, should be 2.55 m at most.

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What is the maximum permissible height of a vehicle including load (excluding vehicles with farming or forestry products)?
explanation: The amount of your vehicle, including cargo (except vehicles agricultural or forestry products) must be at most 4 m.

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: A load extending beyond the back of the vehicle must be marked. Which means are allowed during the day?
explanation: By day following means are permitted at a rearwardly protruding charge: A minimum of 30 x 30 cm large, bright red, transversely to the direction of travel pendulum suspended shield and a bright red, at least 30 x 30 cm large flag held apart by a cross bar. Only the orange warning sign is not enough.
options: A bright red flag of at least 30 x 30 cm held apart by a crossbar
A bright red sign of at least 30 x 30 cm, pendulously mounted transverse to the direction you are travelling in
An orange warning plate

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What precautionary measures must be taken before putting a loading crane into operation?
explanation: Before putting a loading crane you need to be sure that in the swivel range, no electrical lines are and you have to use the lateral supports the vehicle from overturning.
options: Secure the vehicle against tilting with the aid of the side supports
There must not be any electrical lines in the swivelling range
Check whether support is absolutely necessary on the sides

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What are the conditions on which you are allowed to carry out loading on the edge of the roadway?
explanation: If you would like to perform at the roadside a loading operation, please pay attention to stopping restrictions and that the traffic safety is not compromised.
options: You are not allowed to impair traffic safety
You must not ignore any "no stopping" signs
During loading, you are allowed to endanger traffic slightly

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What is the permitted height of a vehicle including load (excluding vehicles with agricultural or forestry products)?
explanation: In the charge allowed (except vehicles agricultural or forestry products) has a height of 4 m.

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What measures must you take if you break down with a load which has to be transported hot (e.g. bitumen transport)?
explanation: In a breakdown with a hot transported cargo, you should organize help ensure the necessary for the charge temperature and secure vehicle.
options: Make sure the vehicle is safe for other road users
Organise help
Ensure the load is kept at the necessary temperature

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What are the rules with which you have to comply when you transport refrigerated goods?
explanation: In a Kühlguttransport please make sure to constantly meet the following the specified temperature and the failure of the cooling appropriate measures to maintain the charge.
options: Constantly monitor compliance with the prescribed temperature
If the refrigeration fails, take appropriate measures to preserve the load
No special rules

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: When transporting certain goods, special regulations must be observed. For which goods does this apply?
explanation: Both for waste materials, as well as live animals and dangerous goods Special regulations must be observed. All answers are correct.
options: For dangerous goods
For waste
For live animals

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: How do you mark a load when it extends laterally by more than 0.4 m beyond the side lights of the vehicle?
explanation: The marking on the side of more than 0.4 m above the vehicle running lights also exceptional charge, you should side forward and with white and carry the side to the rear with red lights.
options: By white side lights to the front and red lateral light to the back
By red side reflectors to the front and red side reflectors to the rear
Marking is not necessary up to a lateral distance of 1 m

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What do you have to make sure of regarding the load on your vehicle?
explanation: When you load your vehicle, please pay attention to compliance with the maximum mass that compliance with the permissible axle loads and the height, width, position and secure the load.
options: - that the gross vehicle weight rating is observed
- that the gross axle weight rating is observed
- the height, width, position and security of the load

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What does this sign mean?
explanation: This panel means waste shipments.
options: - the transport of waste
- ambulance in duty
- army vehicles

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: Where can you find guidelines concerning the transport and securing of loads on vehicles?
explanation: The guidelines you'll find in the road traffic regulations (Highway Code) and accepted engineering standards for securing loads. The registration certificate Part II is not right.
options: In the Road Traffic Act (StVO)
In the generally accepted technical standards on securing loads
In the registration certificate Part II

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: You are transporting a "groupage" cargo load containing transport units of varying sizes and weight. How should you secure this load?
explanation: Do you drive a load handling with different sized and heavy transport units, please pay attention to the loading area dividing into small segments with separating elements and that you secure by positive placement of the transport units, the charge.
options: By using partitions to sub-divide the loading area into smaller segments
By using an interlocking arrangement of the transport units
By ensuring minimum spacing is kept between the transport units

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: You are transporting logs. The driving route means you have to drive along poor quality roads. What do you have to do?
explanation: When tree trunks transport over bad roads, you should regularly review and adjust your driving speed to the road to the cargo securing loads.
options: - regularly check that the load is secure
- adapt my speed to the carriageway and the load
- ensure that the frictional forces between the logs are reduced to the minimum possible level

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What do you have to ensure when taking receipt of a load, if it is expected that transporting this load will create a risk?
explanation: Accepting the award of damaged cargo, you should note that the charge must reject, if you can not avert the danger.
options: - refuse to accept the load if I am unable to avert the risk
- adapt my driving speed to the condition of the load
- conditionally take receipt of the load

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: When are you required to cover bulk material loaded on your vehicle?
explanation: You have to bulk up your vehicle before the fall cover and the eighth from the fact that it can not be blown by the wind down.
options: - could fall off
- could be blown off by the wind
- projects out by more than 40 cm from the drop-sides

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: What forms part of securing the load?
explanation: Part of your load securing that safe stowage and securing and the cover of bulk. An insurance for the charge is not necessary.
options: Safely stowing and securing the load
Covering bulk material
Arranging insurance for the load

chapterName: Receipt Transport And Delivery Of Goods
text: This sign on a vehicle indicates what type of transport?
options: The transport of waste
The transport of hazardous materials
Army transports

text: What must be constantly operative on a motorized bicycle?
explanation: All three are required to be visible on the road and ensure your safety
options: Lights for permanent dipped headlights
Rear light
Rear reflector

text: A bus has 32 passenger seats. How many first-aid kits must be on-board?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: 2 first-aid kits
1 first-aid kit
3 first-aid kits

text: A car is fitted with winter tyres (M+S). A sticker reading "Mit M+S 160" is attached to the dashboard. What does it mean?
explanation: When driving with these tires they must not exceed the speed indicated on the sticker, the tires are not approved for higher speeds. If you drive faster, the tires could overheat and get damaged.
options: You must not drive faster than 160 km/h
The sticker does not apply when the roadway is dry
The sticker does not apply when the roadway is wet due to falling rain

text: What must you remember when fitting winter tyres (M+S)?
explanation: The optimal air pressure for winter tires may be different when there is no snow and the road is dry. It's recommended to increase the air pressure by approx. 0.2 bar compared to summer tires.
options: The air pressure should be slightly higher than with summer tyres (approx. 0.2 bar)
Driving characteristics can be different on dry roadways
The air pressure should be lower than with summer tyres

text: You are driving a regular service bus. Where is the number of permissible seats and standing places indicated?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: In the registration certificate part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
At a clearly visible place inside the bus
On the type plate

text: Which equipment must be carried on a bus in unfavourable road and weather conditions?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Snow chains, spade and hoe
Tow-rope or tow-bar
Portable cable winch

text: Your bus has a permissible total mass of 4 t. What must you carry?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: A powerful torch
Warning triangle and warning lamp
50 litres of reserve fuel in cans

text: What are the requirements to be met by fire extinguishers to be carried on buses?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Authorisation for fire classes A, B, C
At least 6 kg filling material (extinguishing material)
4 kg filling material (extinguishing material)

text: At which intervals must fire extinguishers be checked for usability?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Every 12 months
Every 18 months
Every 24 months

text: What must be clearly marked in buses?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: The location of the first-aid kits
Seats for severely disabled persons in regular traffic
Location of the on-board tools

text: What must you check at the emergency exits before setting off?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Whether they have the devices necessary for opening
Whether they are covered by luggage or other objects
Whether they are lit as required

text: A bus has 15 passenger seats. What is the minimum number of standard first-aid kits required?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: 1 first-aid kit
No first-aid kit is required up to a number of 16 passenger seats

text: What is the minimum number of operative fire extinguishers which must be carried on a bus (single deck)?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: A total of 1 fire extinguisher
From 12 passenger seats onwards, 2 fire extinguishers

text: What is the location of the required fire extinguishers on a double-decker bus?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: Near the driver’s seat
Another one on the upper passenger deck
Another one downstairs before the rear staircase

text: Where can you find the details of the inspection period of a fire extinguisher carried in the vehicle?
explanation: Coming soon...
options: On the inspection tag of the fire extinguisher
On the maintenance log of the fire extinguisher
On the adhesive seal in the registration certificate Part I

text: You are driving a double-decker bus. Where should a fire extinguisher be located?
explanation: According to Section 35g of the Road Traffic Licensing Regulations (StVZO), double-decker buses must carry at least two operational fire extinguishers with a filling mass of 6 kg each. A fire extinguisher should be placed in the immediate vicinity of the driver's seat to provide the driver with quick access in an emergency. The second fire extinguisher must be located on the upper passenger level so that rapid action can be taken there in the event of a fire. This arrangement ensures that both the driver and passengers on both levels of the bus can act quickly in the event of a fire to increase the safety of all occupants.
options: In the immediate vicinity of the driver’s seat
On the upper deck
In the luggage compartment

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: What is the normal trial period?
explanation: Normally, the probationary period is 2 years. But there are also situations where it can be extended to up to 4 years.
options: 2 years
1 year
3 years

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: You are currently in the probationary period and to date have not come to the attention of the authorities. What consequences may result if you fail to observe the traffic sign "Stop. Give way." and thereby endanger other road users?
explanation: Failure to observe the traffic sign "Stop. Grant right of way" is a serious violation, an A violation, which is recorded in the driving qualifying register. In the event of an A-violation or two minor violations (B-violations) within the probationary period, you will have to attend a retraining seminar as a novice driver. You will not have to take an exam again.
options: An order to attend an advanced seminar for new drivers
Entry into the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders
An order to resit a theoretical driving licence test

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: What should be achieved by attending an advanced seminar during the probationary period?
explanation: At the retraining seminar you will learn how to analyze your daily driving behavior and raise your awareness of dangerous situations in the probationary period. Points cannot be deducted with the seminar. This can be done in the driving ability seminar.
options: A more considerate and risk-conscious attitude to driving on public roads
Improved risk awareness
Reducing the number of points in the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: Having committed several violations during the probationary period, the authorities have ordered a driver to attend an advanced seminar. The new driver fails to comply with the order. What may he now anticipate?
explanation: If the novice driver fails to attend the retraining seminar as required, he is threatened with the immediate loss of his driving license. An additional fine will not be imposed. Also, no points will be entered in the register of driver fitness.
options: The withdrawal of the driving licence
A notice to pay a public fine
Additional points in the Central Register of Road Traffic Offenders

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: What should a driving licence applicant anticipate if he is found driving without a licence?
explanation: A person who wants to obtain a driving license not only has to bring along the necessary physical and mental requirements. In addition, he must not have repeatedly violated traffic regulations or penal laws. This would show that the applicant is not suitable for driving a motor vehicle. The same applies to driving without a license. Should a person, who wants to obtain a driving license, drive without one, the authorities might not allow you to attend the exam.
options: The driving licence authority may withdraw the application inspection order
A test may be ordered to ascertain your aptitude for driving motor vehicles
No consequences, as long as you are registered with a driving school

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: A learner driver has committed several violations during the probationary period. The authority has ordered that the driver attends a supplementary driving course. The learner driver fails to comply with this order. What can they expect to happen?
explanation: The probationary period for novice drivers is 2 years. During this time, very strict penalties from the catalogue of fines apply. If you commit an A offence or two B offences during the probationary period, you will be ordered to attend an advanced training seminar (ASF). If you do not comply with this official order, your driving licence will be revoked.
options: The withdrawal of their driving licence
An extension of the probationary period by another 3 years
An order to attend a driver fitness session

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: A driving licence applicant practices practical driving skills without a driving instructor on public roads. What should he expect if the police perform a check on him?
explanation:
As a driving licence applicant, you are not allowed to drive on public roads without a instructor. Driving without a license is a criminal offence and can be punished with a fine or prison sentence.
The police can order a check of your ability to drive. As a driving license applicant, you run the risk of never receiving a driving license.
options: A criminal prosecution
A review of his fitness to drive a motor vehicle
No consequences provided he is accompanied in the vehicle by a holder of a driving licence

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: You are transporting commercial goods with a truck. What is the purpose of the 35-hour further training course, which you must attend within 5 years?
explanation: When transporting commercial goods, the aim of the 35-hour training course is to increase health awareness and refresh knowledge of the regulations for freight transport.
options: To increase awareness of health
To refresh my knowledge of the road haulage regulations
To acquire additional driving licence classes

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: Working as a professional driver requires you to complete a basic qualification and to regularly attend training programmes. Where will you find information concerning the validity period of your professional driver’s basic qualification?
explanation: You can find the information about the time limit on the back of your driving licence.
options: On my driving licence
On the driver card
On the website of the Federal Motor Transport Authority

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: You are a commercial bus driver. What is the purpose of the 35-hour further training course, which you must attend within 5 years?
explanation: If you are transporting people commercially by bus, within 35-hour training course you will learn how to increase health awareness and refresh your knowledge of the regulations for passenger transport. Participation is compulsory.
options: To increase awareness of health
To refresh my knowledge of the passenger transport regulations
To acquire additional driving licence classes

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: What can lead to a review of your fitness to be a bus driver?
options: - my physical capabilities
- my mental capacity
- the reliability of my employer

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: When can the authorities order a bus driver to undergo a fitness assessment?
options: If the driver has seriously violated road traffic regulations
If the driver has committed a serious road traffic offence
If there are indications that the bus driver has a high potential for aggression

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: After receiving your Class C driving licence for the first time, you want to transport goods commercially. How can you meet the requirements?
options: - the accelerated initial qualification
- a professional driver training programme
- a 35-hour advanced training course

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: After receiving your Class D driving licence for the first time, you want to transport passengers commercially. How can you meet the requirements?
options: - the accelerated initial qualification
- a professional driver training programme
- a 35-hour advanced training course

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: To be employed as a professional driver, you will need an initial qualification as well as regular training. How are the relevant proofs documented?
explanation: Professional drivers who work in the transport of goods or passengers on public roads require an initial qualification and then regular further training. The validity of these trainings are documented on the driver qualification certificate.
options: On the driver qualification card
In the Federal Motor Vehicle and Transport Authority’s professional driver qualification register (KBA)
On the webpage of my driver licensing agency

themeName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
chapterName: Qualification And Ability Of Truck Drivers
text: What is documented on the driver qualification card?
explanation: Professional drivers who work in the transport of goods or passengers on public roads require an initial qualification and then regular further training. The validity of these trainings are documented on the driver qualification certificate.
options: - initial qualification
- training
- the issued driver’s licence
